text: {"lessons":["A short run of volatile monthly returns is not evidence of a predictable trend, so I should avoid forecasting from recent price moves.","Selling some Stock A after a large gain reduced concentration and locked in proceeds, but I should make such decisions based on portfolio risk and future prospects—not simply to realize a gain.","I should review diversification and risk regularly even when I make no trades, and avoid letting my average cost or reluctance to admit a mistake drive decisions."]}
